headline: Record year closes with margin gains despite deal costs
summary_short: Cintas reported revenue of $2,905.2M, up 8.9% y/y (8.4% organic) and 2.2% q/q, while diluted EPS rose 15.6% y/y to $1.26 ($1.29 adjusted, +18.3% ex UniFirst deal costs).
summary_long: Revenue was $2,905.2M, +8.9% y/y (8.4% organic) and +2.2% q/q. Gross margin reached 51.0% of revenue, +130bp y/y, tying the all-time high. Operating income rose 15.2% y/y to $688.2M despite absorbing $14.0M of UniFirst-deal transaction costs. Net income rose 14.0% y/y to $511.0M as the effective tax rate fell to 21.2% from 22.1% on discrete stock-compensation tax items. Diluted EPS rose 15.6% y/y to $1.26 ($1.29 adjusted, +18.3%). FY2026 free cash flow was $1,881.2M; Cintas returned $1.65B to shareholders via buybacks and dividends. Cintas initiated FY2027 guidance: revenue of $12.10B-$12.25B and adjusted diluted EPS of $5.36-$5.50, excluding the pending UniFirst acquisition.

drivers.explanation: 8.4% organic growth (ex-FX, ex-acquisitions) drove most of the 8.9% y/y increase; management cited broad growth across all business segments.
Gross margin hit 51.0% of revenue, tying the all-time high; CEO attributed it to employee-partner performance and technology, capacity and talent investment.
+15.2% y/y despite absorbing $14.0M of UniFirst-acquisition transaction expenses that the release breaks out as a discrete drag on the line.
Effective tax rate fell to 21.2% from 22.1%, which the release attributes to discrete items, primarily stock-based-compensation tax accounting.
UniFirst transaction costs cut $0.03 off diluted EPS; adjusted diluted EPS of $1.29 rose 18.3% y/y excluding that cost.

CEO called it an outstanding year on record revenue and margins; near-term overhang is the pending UniFirst deal, which received an FTC Second Request on June 11, 2026 and is still expected to close H2 calendar 2026.
